purpose: Repository-backed persistent project memory for the KAYAS DCTS topology. Future topology changes should be reconciled against this file and the canonical source model before viewer regeneration/deployment.

deployment.navigation_contract: KAYAS portal links to Interactive Architecture; topology viewer provides a persistent ← KAYAS return control.

canonical_graph.rule: Never promote OPEN / PROPOSED intent to CONFIRMED without explicit evidence.

current_visual_baseline.production: v0.11.9 remains the accepted live production viewer until v0.12 T00 is manually accepted.
current_visual_baseline.T00_preview: v0.12.0 WP8 replaces the layered WP1-WP7 preview composition with one clean T00 implementation loaded directly over the v0.11.9 canonical viewer. The WP8 layout uses fixed non-overlapping External, Security, Cloud, Digital Core, Storage, Data Protection and Management/OOB/Analytics regions with larger investor-facing labels and a simplified high-level flow overlay.
current_visual_baseline.T00_navigation_contract: External / Service Ingress -> T01; Security -> T02; Data Center Digital Core defaults to T02 with explicit T02 Network and T04 Compute controls; Physical Connectivity CTA -> T03; Storage -> T04; Management/OOB/Analytics -> T05; Cloud Service Platform and Data Protection -> T06. Component cards preserve selected canonical object and open its controlled focus view in the target T-view.
current_visual_baseline.T00_click_hardening: WP8 does not rely on inherited inline onclick handlers. It uses capture-phase delegated click/keyboard activation on data-t00-target elements and stops T00 navigation events from bubbling into the base scene pan handler before switching view.
current_visual_baseline.T00_hover_contract: Hover/focus retains overall architecture context with moderate dimming and a stable top-right context pill. Flow emphasis is limited to short evidence-safe architecture associations.
current_visual_baseline.T01: Executive 5/5 visual pass remains in v0.11.9 pending a later dedicated review after T00 acceptance.
current_visual_baseline.top_right_controls: Only the functional ← KAYAS return control is shown; placeholder Search/Help/Settings icons are removed.

scope: Remove T00 visual overlap caused by accumulated preview layers
Increase investor-facing card and label legibility
Use a single simplified evidence-safe architecture-flow overlay
Harden whole-section and component click navigation with delegated capture-phase events
Keep T01-T06 base viewer behavior unchanged
development_checkpoint.promotion_rule: Do not replace production index.html until WP8 visual readability and T00->T01-T06 click navigation are manually accepted by the user.

current_open_reconciliation.issue: Normalized KAYAS object currently carries VENDOR=H3C while verified official manufacturer sources identify AISHU.
current_open_reconciliation.action: Do not silently change the canonical vendor field; reconcile against project source evidence first.

change_workflow: 1. Record the new evidence or explicit design decision.
2. Update the canonical object/relationship model with status and source traceability.
3. Preserve superseded values/revision history; do not overwrite silently.
4. Regenerate synchronized T00-T06 views from the same model.
5. Run evidence-safety and visual-routing acceptance checks.
6. Update viewer version and this project-memory file.
7. Publish a self-contained direct static kayas/topology/index.html; do not reintroduce runtime payload fetch/decompression as a production dependency.
8. Verify both /kayas/ -> topology and topology -> /kayas/ navigation.
memory_instruction: Treat this repository file as the authoritative persistent DCTS/KAYAS project memory when continuing topology work in future conversations. Read it before making topology changes if current project context is incomplete.
